name: Mérida, Mexico

visa.notes: Temporary resident visa requires ~$1,500/mo income or ~$25,000 savings.

rent.notes: Unfurnished 3BR houses in regular Merida neighborhoods (Tixcacal, Las Americas, Montecarlo, Temozon, Montes de Ame) list at 14,000-26,000 MXN/mo (about 750-1,390 USD at 18.75 MXN/USD); furnished 3BR listings have a median around 32,000 MXN. Rio Times Sep 2026 puts 2BR unfurnished at ~530 USD and a 92 m2 unit at ~943 USD. Typical assumes a pet-friendly 3BR house around 20,000 MXN.

sources.title: Trovit - renta departamento 3 recamaras Merida
Rio Times - Cost of Living Merida Expats 2026
Mitula - departamentos 3 recamaras Merida

groceries.notes: Rio Times Sep 2026 gives 150-300 USD/mo per person for groceries in Merida, i.e. 300-500 for a couple; typical adds roughly 90-110 USD/mo of large-breed kibble for a 100 lb dog (about 13-15 kg/month), which is an estimate not separately priced. Mexican food inflation is running near the 3.6% headline (Oct 2026), so no basket shock.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of Living Merida Expats 2026
UnoTV - Inflacion en Mexico llega a 3.62% en octubre

utilities.notes: Rio Times Sep 2026: combined utilities incl. internet 88-177 USD/mo; water about 3 USD/mo. Internet (about 20-35) removed here. Electricity dominates: Yucatan homes are on CFE tariff 1C/1D with summer subsidy Apr-Oct, but a 2-3BR house running AC can fall into DAC at 4-7 MXN/kWh, which drives the max. Includes LP gas and trash.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of Living Merida Expats 2026

healthcare.notes: Min = IMSS Seguro de Salud para la Familia for two residents aged 60-69 at 19,800 MXN/yr each (39,600 MXN/yr, about 176 USD/mo at 18.75), paid annually, pre-existing conditions excluded. Private gastos medicos mayores for ages 56-65 runs 80,000-140,000 MXN/yr per person (Apr 2026 survey, up 12-15% vs 2025), i.e. about 710-1,245 USD/mo for two at full coverage (max). Typical = IMSS for two plus a lower-cost/high-deductible private plan, the mix expat retirees commonly carry; re-modeled so this category carries the full health-coverage cost.

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (250 = health) to renters/contents only. Tenant contents-only policies in Mexico run 1,500-4,000 MXN/yr (May 2026), about 7-18 USD/mo at 18.75 MXN/USD. Health coverage now sits entirely in healthcare.

sources.title: CuantoMeCuesta - Seguro incendio/temblor y contenidos, mayo 2026

petCare.notes: Merida vet visits run 481-739 MXN (avg 600). Bravecto flea/tick for a large dog is about 899-999 MXN per 3 months (20-40 kg size; 40-56 kg slightly more). Annual model: 2 visits, core vaccines, 4 Bravecto doses and heartworm preventive, roughly 8,000-10,000 MXN/yr = 35-45 USD/mo at 18.75.

sources.title: Cronoshare - precios veterinario Merida
Rappi - Bravecto antipulgas para perro precio

petDaycare.notes: Profeco (Revista del Consumidor) boarding rates for large breeds are 250-495 MXN per night nationally (article updated Nov 2026). Model: about 4 boarding nights per month averaged plus occasional daycare days = 1,000-2,000 MXN/mo (53-107 USD); max covers a 10-night trip month.

sources.title: TV Azteca - Cuanto cuesta dejar a un perro en una pension o guarderia

petGrooming.notes: National 2026 guide: bath for a giant long-haired dog 420-520 MXN, bath plus cut/brush-out 480-550 MXN. One full groom per month for a Bernese = about 500-600 MXN (27-32 USD at 18.75); max allows a second deshedding bath in hot months.

sources.title: Cronoshare - Cuanto cuesta un servicio de peluqueria canina (Jan 2026)

transportation.notes: One modest car: Magna gasoline 23.90 MXN/L in Merida (Profeco, Sep 2026); 80 L/mo = about 1,900 MXN (100 USD); cobertura amplia auto insurance averages 12,500-15,800 MXN/yr (56-70 USD/mo, Nov 2026); plus maintenance and Yucatan registration. Min = no car: Va y Ven bus 0.71 USD/trip (seniors discounted) plus Uber/DiDi from 1.47 USD.

entertainment.notes: Home internet: Telmex 120 Mbps ~21 USD, Totalplay 150 Mbps ~35, Izzi gigabit ~51 (Rio Times Sep 2026). Plus ~30 USD streaming, mid-range dinner for two 30-60 USD about 4x/month, and activities/cenotes/concerts.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of Living Merida Expats 2026

phoneCell.notes: National carrier pricing: Movistar Plan Pro 20 GB 309 MXN/mo, AT&T prepaid 200 MXN for 12 GB, Telcel Amigo Sin Limite 200 MXN per 30 days (Nov 2026 tables). Two lines = 400-620 MXN/mo, about 21-33 USD at 18.75; max allows two higher-tier Telcel postpaid plans. Stored 81 reflected US-style pricing.

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: Private GP visit about 29 USD and specialist 40-80 USD in Merida (Rio Times Sep 2026); typical assumes 1-2 private visits plus labs/dental per month for the couple beyond premiums. Stored range still fits.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of Living Merida Expats 2026

healthcare.system: IMSS public system; several good private hospitals (Star Médica, Centro Médico de las Américas).

pros.text: One of the safest cities in Mexico (consistently top-3 in INEGI ENSU perception-of-safety surveys)
